after.zh: 亮点被处理成什么样，就是这种处理的「印章」：每个输入像素都盖一个，挪到对应位置、乘上权重再相加。把权重排成 3×3 的小方阵，就是核。
after.en: Whatever a bright dot is turned into is the "stamp" of the processing: every input pixel presses one, moved to its place, multiplied by its weight and added up. Arrange the weights in a small 3×3 grid and you have a kernel.

t.zh: 三点平均、方块模糊、差分，都是把挪了位置的几份原图乘上系数再加起来。换一组挪法和系数，就是另一种效果。
t.en: The three-point average, the box blur and the differences all add up a few shifted copies of the picture, each multiplied by a number. A different set of shifts and numbers gives a different effect.

t.zh: 有人用这样一组挪法和系数处理了几张图，你只看得到输入和输出。第一组测试只有一个亮点。
t.en: Someone processed a few pictures with such a set of shifts and numbers, and you can only see the inputs and outputs. The first test is a single bright dot.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：一个亮点进去
caption.en: Set 1: one bright dot goes in

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：用平移、常数和四则运算，搭出同样的处理。要想的问题：一个亮点经过处理，变成了什么？
t.en: Your task in this level: build the same processing out of shifts, constants, multiplications and additions. Something to think about: what does a single bright dot turn into?

brief.zh: 有人用一种邻居加权和处理了这些图。用平移、常数和四则运算，搭出同样的处理。
brief.en: Someone processed these images with a weighted sum of neighbours. Build the same processing out of shifts, constants, multiplications and additions.

hint.zh: 先看亮点那一组：一个亮点变成了几个点？各在哪里，各有多亮？
hint.en: Look at the bright dot first: how many dots did one dot turn into? Where is each, and how bright?
